biotools.summary: DENSE (DE Novo emerged gene SEarch) is a Nextflow pipeline for identifying de novo emerged genes in eukaryotes. It combines phylostratigraphy and genome comparisons and is accessible via a command-line tool and a web server for the filtering step.
